name: Bak Kwa
summary: Square sheets of sweet barbecued dried pork, grilled over charcoal on a wire mesh until the sugar glaze turns glossy red-brown and the edges char black. Four sheets lie stacked and fanned on a square of white greaseproof paper, each draping over the edge of the one beneath, oil soaking into the paper around them.
